culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total Investment Portfolio and Cash Equivalents | $ | 712,272 | $ | 716,303 | 127.65 | %

findings.detail: The source SOI has a populated Percentage of Net Assets column totaling 127.65%, but the extracted A07 percentage sum is 0.0%.

rationale: A07 is an aggregate CIK-quarter flag with no row localization, so I used the filing schedule total as the anchor. The oracle artifact reports pct_sum=0.0%, while the raw SOI total row reports Total Investment Portfolio and Cash Equivalents fair value of 716,303 and Percentage of Net Assets of 127.65%. Because the source percentage column is present and nonzero, the zero extracted percentage sum is a real extraction gap rather than a false alarm.
